notes.title: Tiny Island is Going Full Release
notes.notes:
[b]Huge news everyone! [/b]

Tiny Island is going full release on the 24th of May! The full version will include the complete island story, some improved mechanics, and new interactions! 

The other big thing is that the game will be lowered in price and will cost $4,99 starting the 24th of May!

[previewyoutube=ctqg7DnIV28;full][/previewyoutube]

Also, due to your feedback, we decided to remove the free mode from the game as it is not as amusing as we wanted it to be. 

Furthermore, we wish to thank everyone who played the game during the Early Access and shared their thoughts with us – that was really helpful and inspiring! 

[i][b]And now Jump into the fluffy adventure and see you on Tiny Island!
[/b][/i]

And that's how you build structures[/b]

notes.title: TINY ISLAND IS OUT ON EARLY ACCESS
notes.notes:
Hey all! 
[u][b]
TINY ISLAND IS OUT IN STEAM EARLY ACCESS! HURAAAAAY![/b][/u]

[b]Grab the Early Access version right now! We hope you’ll have a lot of fun![/b]

notes.title: The Creation of Art
notes.notes:
[i][b]Hey! We are so happy that you loved our brand new key art, so we decided to unravel the tiny path of how it has been made. [/b][/i]

[b]The first step [/b]is the idea and the source of inspiration. We were looking for some recognizable image that would correlate with the Tiny Island concept. The searching took a while, but suddenly our producer came up with the idea of homaging Michelangelo’s “The Creation of Adam”. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41163597/dfb83351d4dcfd7e48e29b2cbeeb78c2f93a2ef4.png[/img]

The idea was so cool, and we decided to give it a roll! 
And thanks to amazing artists from [b]Happy Fox Studios[/b] and their first drafts we realized that the core idea was cool indeed^^

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41163597/2c882a4ca5cac17004d5127d15daae874028a48d.jpg[/img]

There goes the next iteration. On that step, we decided that the plate would be more appropriate than a barrel. And there were some thoughts about changing the tiny one’s wardrobe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41163597/7a4a20ede54f766d55a5eefcb7e34ce7fad04268.jpg[/img]

Just have a look at this fancy plate^^

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41163597/05ac91cc330e7d8f15847f179a77c9a613330a4a.jpg[/img]

Aaaaand we are one step closer to the finale

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41163597/cdf0e131d4821e70d980a508d375de51c5c69de1.jpg[/img]

Now we just need to put some colors on. And we also need to choose the color scheme that is touching our heartstrings the most. By the way, which one would you prefer?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41163597/0aa95df48fbfdf0de8fb3d7fd45a0077afb5fb2e.jpg[/img]

Now it is time for a couple of finishing touches. 
And the new wonderful Tiny Island’s key art is ready to mesmerize^^

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41163597/0c58d00b9eeb010a122f96262911b7b4f5a5a367.jpg[/img]

Check more mesmerizing and fluffy stuff on our Discord - https://discord.gg/Rx6Sydqc4R

notes.title: Dev Diaries #1: Shadow Play
notes.notes:
Hey!
 
Guess it is time to lift a curtain a little bit and show you how the development is going! And we decided to tell you about Tiny Island’s… SHADOW PLAY!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41163597/4fe146321e525b23d6156e55955b264cb415bea8.gif[/img]

Shadow play in Tiny Island plays the role of the narrative elements that will familiarize players with the game events, and also will introduce the islands and conclude the local story arcs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41163597/deeac506f48248898dd328318cf7f7a88788d6f1.jpg[/img]

We assembled the real-life set to watch how the lights and shadows work in this environment and also to check the expressiveness of the silhouettes. That helped us to decide how to carry it to the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41163597/4fe146321e525b23d6156e55955b264cb415bea8.gif[/img]

It took a couple of hours to construct and test the set. The same thing in the game will take a week or so. And it will be a while before all of the animations will be finalized.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41163597/6064f886a8c0a486393d199087eb9e8a2e4f67d7.gif[/img]

To be honest, we didn’t receive much valuable information for the development, but we certainly felt the atmosphere of magic that brings the Shadow Play. And for some of us that was the first time to watch such kind of show…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41163597/b5a422366e98b19b398870a902cfcb8fa794ab2c.gif[/img]

And the main thing: it was the avant-garde version of the Romeo & Juliet^^

For other news from the theatrical life of Tiny Island visit our Discord server: https://discord.gg/Rx6Sydqc4R

notes.title: Tiny Island's tiny FAQ
notes.notes:
Hey! Tiny Island's development is going great and there're some huge announcements to come.

So we decided to share our updated FAQ with you^^

[b]What is the Tiny Island? [/b]
Tiny Island is a single-player VR God simulator where you will help cute tiny people with a chopsticks

[b]Can I try the game? [/b]
There’s a demo coming to Steam soon

[b]When the full game will be available? [/b]
We schedule to release Tiny Island in 2022. More information to come

[b]Are there any violence or inappropriate content in the game?[/b]
Definitely not, only meditative gameplay full of serenity and kind humor

[b]How many playable islands will be in the release version? [/b]
There will be three islands in the release version (not counting the tutorial island), each with its own visual design correlated to the season of the year

[b]Do you plan to add some new content after the release? [/b]
We are focusing on the core of Tiny Island right now. But we’re certainly thinking about the possible game extensions

[b]May I see some cute gif from the game?[/b]
Sure! There you go^^

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41163597/35502db3952a1ff2f90b3c2d2e6c7228e60629c1.gif[/img]

[b]How do I leave my feedback?[/b]
Feel free to contact us on Tiny Island's Discord server: https://discord.gg/Rx6Sydqc4R
